text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Drawn in by the upbeat rhythm,
I casually stepped into a club, but――

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Woohoooooo♪♪
Those are some pretty slick steps, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hitting it off with Tap Dance City and the others
who happened to be there, they danced in pure ecstasy!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Phew~~... That was a great sweat!
I can really feel my heart pounding along with these tracks!

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, this next song will be our last!
With this, our club will be... closing down.
Please enjoy yourselves until the very end!"

text_block_list.name: Tap's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Turns out they were in the red. What a shock!
To think such an awesome place is closing down...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I know, right? We've been hanging out at this place
ever since we first started rolling together.
choice_data_list: ...I want to make it the best possible grand finale.
...I want to make it the best possible grand finale.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Nah, this isn't gonna be the last time, you know?
Because—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What I'm aiming for is to build a castle where everyone can live happily together!
And I'll rebuild this club inside those very castle walls!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: The rebuilding costs! The operating funds! I'll earn every last penny by winning races!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Haha! If you chicken out just 'cause it's reckless, you'll never protect the places where you can fool around!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I won't let these so-called "grown-up reasons"
steal away my memories with my friends or the place where I belong!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So boasted Tap Dance City.
The resolve in her unwavering gaze showed she meant every word.
If it's her, then just maybe...
choice_data_list: ...In that case, I'd better recharge my energy.
...In that case, I'd better recharge my energy.
Got it, I'll cheer you on with everything I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If we're talking about that, it's gotta be meat!
Boss, bring out the tastiest meat in the house!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A pre-celebration for rebuilding the club!
Let's throw a huuuuge party to hype things up!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
Once the club reopens, you've gotta come by too!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
All right, now that that's settled, time to train!
So I can become an Umamusume who rakes in the big bucks!
